title: Noon sakinah and meem sakinah together: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-'Alaq 13 to 19, At-Tin and meem sakinah
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 27 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Noon sakinah and meem sakinah together rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 27. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Noon sakinah and tanween
Meem sakinah
rows: Idgham: ي ر م ل و ن

keywords.def: a meem with no vowel (a sukoon or no mark)
hiding the meem before baa, lips closed, with ghunnah
merging meem into meem, with ghunnah
saying the meem clearly before every other letter

questions.q: Label the rule in «أَمْرٍ» (97:4) and «مِّن كُلِّ» (97:4).
questions.a: أَمْرٍ: meem sakinah before ر, izhar shafawi; مِّن كُلِّ: noon sakinah before ك, ikhfa.

questions.q: Mixed hunt (pupil PDF): label six marked words in Al-Qadr and At-Tin. Today's rota group recites At-Tin 95:6 to 8 to the teacher.
questions.a: Answers on the teacher sheet: each word labelled noon or meem with the correct rule.

questions.q: Extend: write one example of each meem rule from surahs we know.
questions.a: For example: يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ (ikhfa), رَبِّهِم مِّن (idgham), أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ (izhar).

questions.q: Stretch: make a three-question quiz on meem sakinah for a partner.
questions.a: Three clear questions with correct answers.
A) Noon sakinah: ikhfa. Noon sakinah before ق, one of the 15 ikhfa letters.

questions.q: In 96:14, the meem of «أَلَمْ» comes before ي. Its rule is ...
Think again: Noon sakinah has 4 rules and meem sakinah has 3. Which rule do you think is easiest to get wrong, and why?
questions.a: Often iqlab and ikhfa shafawi, because they sound the same; or izhar shafawi before و and ف.
